thread:
maria: Heads-up — since the NCCL 3.1.0 bump in ap-east canary we've seen intermittent p2p stalls for multi-GPU inference jobs. Latency SLOs spiking on small-batch collation.
ajay: seeing the same on a100 pools, but only when H100s are in the same node mix. single-model jobs on pure A100 nodes look fine.
maria: exact symptom: allreduce hangs then retries, job-level timeout -> autoscaler kicks then jobs fail.
linus: can you paste kernel logs and NCCL traces? also which driver version?
maria: driver is 535.54, CUDA 12.1, NCCL 3.1.0. stack sample:
```
I0321 12:34:56 worker.cc:212] NCCL operation allreduce timeout after 60s
ncclCommAbort: nccl p2p error, NET/IB: timeout
Stack: nccl::transport::p2p-send -> nccl::coll::allreduce
```
ops-jen: dmesg shows repeated nvlink flaps on nodes that have a100+h100 mix:
```
[ 1234.567890] nvlink: NVLink link 4 reset
[ 1234.567895] GPU 1: fatal P2P reset
```
karen: interesting — we only rolled the NCCL bits, left the infra driver and fw same. Did NCCL change p2p fallback order?
ajay: NCCL 3.1 changed some p2p routing heuristics. it tries direct links more aggressively and can deadlock on mixed topologies if link negotiation fails.
ops-dave: quick repro script shows hangs within 2-3 mins on mixed nodes, not repro on homogeneous nodes.
maria: temporary mitigation: set env NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 for inference replicas. reduces perf but stable. anyone tried NCCL_SHM_DISABLE?
linus: NCCL_P2P_DISABLE helped in canary. perf hit ~20% but no hangs. NCCL_SHM_DISABLE didn't change.
ops-jen: can we pin scheduling to pure-A100 nodes as a short-term? but capacity is tight for ap-east.
karen: capacity-wise we have ~10% spare on A100-only pools but a lot of jobs are tagged "mixed" by K8s nodeSelector. we can patch deployment to prefer a100-only for latency-critical fleets.
ajay: long-term we should either roll back NCCL to 3.0.x or coordinate firmware/driver changes with NCCL vendors. 3.0 had no p2p aggressiveness.
maria: ops: recommend targeted rollback of NCCL in ap-east canary and stop further global rollout. schedule rollback window tonight 01:00 local.
ops-jen: ack — will prepare rollback playbook and a canary subset (10 nodes) to validate. alerting runbook updated.
sre-bot: [incident created] INC-2026-045: ap-east inference p2p stalls after NCCL 3.1.0 rollout. priority: high. responders: ops-jen, maria, ajay.
karen: also filing a ticket to model infra to avoid mixed-node placement for critical routes until fixed.
linus: note for postmortem: include nvlink firmware versions — some H100 nodes are on older fw that might not negotiate well.
ops-dave: I'll capture NVLink topologies: `nvidia-smi topo -m` and include in the ticket.
maria: plan: (1) patch inference service to set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE env; (2) short rollback to NCCL 3.0.5 in canary; (3) block global rollout; (4) investigate firmware interplay for mixed nodes.
karen: agreed. communicate to support and customers that we expect <1h disruption for critical canary rollback, will follow up.
ajay: one more: add healthcheck metric for nccl allreduce latency so we can auto-detect earlier.
maria: thanks all, rolling actions now. :thumbsup:
